original_ai_output.title_zh: 约贝州法院判处一名男子死刑，其罪名是杀害妻子
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚约贝州高等法院在达马图鲁判处45岁男子阿布巴卡尔·穆萨死刑，罪名是杀害其42岁的妻子阿米·阿达穆·马曼。穆萨此前辩称无罪，声称有其他人闯入其住所行凶，但法院认定检方已排除合理怀疑地证明其有罪。法官告知其可在30天内上诉。该报道目前为单一来源。

location.raw_text: Yobe State High Court sitting in Damaturu

key_facts.fact: 约贝州高等法院在达马图鲁判处45岁男子阿布巴卡尔·穆萨死刑
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A Yobe State High Court sitting in Damaturu on Thursday sentenced a 45-year-old man, Abubakar Musa, popularly known as Daddy, to death by hanging for the killing of his wife, Ammi Adamu Mamman.

key_facts.fact: 穆萨被控对其42岁妻子犯有杀人罪，2024年1月4日被捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Musa was arrested by operatives of the Yobe State Police Command on January 4, 2024, following the death of his 42-year-old wife at their residence in New Bra-Bra Housing Estate, Damaturu. He was subsequently charged with culpable homicide.

key_facts.fact: 穆萨在庭审中辩称无罪，声称有其他人闯入其住所杀害其妻子
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Musa pleaded not guilty to the charge, maintaining through his lawyers that other persons had broken into their home and killed his wife.

key_facts.fact: 法官认定检方已排除合理怀疑地证明其有罪，并告知其可在30天内上诉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Justice Kaigama found Musa guilty of culpable homicide, ruling that the prosecution had proved its case beyond reasonable doubt.

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
穆萨关于他人闯入行凶的说法未获法院采信，相关情节未获独立证实
